questions.q: On which island was John when he saw the revelation?
questions.evidence: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ

questions.q: Neither hot nor cold, what does Jesus call the assembly in Laodicea?
questions.evidence: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth

questions.q: Who has overcome to open the book, the elder tells John?
options: The Lion of the tribe of Judah
questions.evidence: Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome
answerTerms: lion who is of the tribe of judah

questions.q: How many were sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel?
questions.evidence: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel

questions.q: Who made war on the dragon with his angels?
questions.evidence: Michael and his angels made war on the dragon

questions.q: What is the number of the beast?
questions.evidence: His number is six hundred sixty-six

questions.q: What did John see when the first heaven and earth had passed away?
options: A new heaven and a new earth
questions.evidence: I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth have passed away, and the sea is no more
answerTerms: new heaven and a new earth

questions.q: What will God wipe away from their eyes?
questions.evidence: He will wipe away from them every tear from their eyes

questions.q: How does the one who testifies say he is coming?
questions.evidence: He who testifies these things says, “Yes, I come quickly
